|   No. | Message                          | Contents                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
|-------|----------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|   097 | P TYPE NOT ALLOWED (AUTO EXEC)   | P type cannot be directed when the program is restarted. (After power ON. after emergency stop or P/S alarm 94 to 97 were reset, no automatic operation was performed. Perform automatic operation.                          |
|   098 | G28 FOUND IN SEQUENCE RETURN     | A command of the program restart was specified without the reference position return operation after power ON or emergency stop, and G28 was found during search. Perform the reference position return.                     |
|   099 | MDI EXEC NOT ALLOWED AFT. SEARCH | After completion of search in program restart, a move command is given with MDI. Move axis before a move command or don" t interrupt MDI operation.                                                                          |
|   100 | PARAMETER WRITE ENABLE           | On the PARAMETER (SETTING) screen, PWE (parameter writing enabled) is set to 1. set it to 0, then reset the system.                                                                                                          |
|   101 | PLEASE CLEAR MEMORY              | The power turned off while rewriting the memory by program edit operation. If this alarm has occurred, press (RESET) while pressing <PROG>, and only the program being edited will be deleted. Register the deleted program. |
|   109 | P/S ALARM                        | A value other than 0 or 1 was specified after P in the G08 code, or no value was specified.                                                                                                                                  |
|   111 | CALCULATED DATA OVERFLOW         | The result of calculation is out of the allowable range (-10 47 to -10 29 , 0, and -10 29 to 10 47 ).                                                                                                                        |
|   112 | DIVIDED BY ZERO                  | Division by zero was specified (including tan 90s). Modify the program.                                                                                                                                                      |
|   113 | IMPROPER COMMAND                 | A function which cannot be used in custom macro is command. Modify the program.                                                                                                                                              |
|   114 | FORMAT ERROR IN MACRO            | There is an error in other formats than (Formula). Modify the program.                                                                                                                                                       |
